components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. Accepted with optional spaces,
            dashes and brackets and an optional leading '+' country code; stored and returned
            in E.164 form (a '+' then 8 to 15 digits). A number without a country code is
            assumed to be '+61' with a single leading '0' dropped.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 25
          pattern: '^[+0-9 ()\-]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Optional; when supplied it must be a
            syntactically valid address and is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. Optional; when not supplied it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: When true, allows creating this owner even though another owner already has the
            same last name at the same address (an intentionally shared household). Write-only request
            flag; not persisted.
          type: boolean
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone

      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'

              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name

I implemented shared-household support for `POST /api/owners`. The `sharesHousehold` request flag already existed (it made `CheckHouseholdUnique` skip the same-lastName/same-address duplicate rejection). The new piece was assigning and returning a stable shared `householdId`.

Changes:

Uses the same case/whitespace normalization as `CheckHouseholdUnique`. No id is assigned when the flag isn't set.

2. **`owners.POST.yml`** — wired `assignHousehold` into the pipeline (after `build`, before `assignCustomerCode`, under `govern: [ transaction ]`).

3. **`Owner` entity** — added a persisted `householdId` field (`@Column(name = "household_id")`) with getter/setter, mirroring `customerCode`.

4. **`openapi.yml`** — added `householdId` as a read-only field on the `Owner` response schema. The generated `OwnerDto` picks it up and MapStruct auto-maps it by name (same as `customerCode`).

5. **DB schemas** — added a `household_id` column to the owners table in all four schemas (hsqldb/h2/mysql/postgres; the test profile uses hsqldb with `ddl-auto=none`), and appended the matching trailing `NULL` to the column-less seed inserts in the hsqldb and mysql `data.sql` files (h2/postgres already use explicit column lists).
